name: Jeeter | Kiwi Kush | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Kiwi Kush is an indica with a flavor that lives up to its name. The inhale bursts with ripe kiwi and tropical sweetness, while the exhale adds a tangy mix of spice and earth. Refreshing and flavorful, Kiwi Kush brings a crisp fruit twist to classic kush.
